Players Committee card image of [[Endor: Ewok Village (V) (Errata 2)]] (image 3, Errata 2; no errata mark is printed), game text: “'''Light Side:''' While a Skywalker here, Prophecy Of The Force may not relocate from here. '''Dark Side:''' No starships or vehicles here.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/endorewokvillage.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6489b69cc5f1545e5e24ac7b2d68ae446cf03769 6489b69] (10 July 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
